pure-announcement.rationale: The page is a truncated explainer capture whose only body text is an Agensi marketplace promo line, which is promotional but not literally a product launch, release note, or funding announcement.

duplicate.rationale: The only substantive claim captured — SKILL.md is an open standard portable across Claude Code, Cursor, and other agents — is already fully covered by the existing agent-skills-format concept, which additionally explains progressive disclosure and context economics, so a reader of it learns nothing new here.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The one claim present (a SKILL.md standard adopted across many agents) is checkable against the published agentskills.io specification.

durability.rationale: Beyond the teaser sentence, the capture contains only a time-bound marketplace availability promo ('Now open worldwide... Start selling') with nothing that stays useful.

actionability.rationale: There is nothing to act on: the explainer content failed to capture, leaving no guidance, mechanism, or decision input.

atomicity.rationale: The single idea present is an undeveloped one-line teaser borrowed from the page's meta description, with no body to state a core idea from.
